fixed.summary: A normal-mapped model's MikkTSpace tangent is stored as its angle across the vertex normal (15 bits and the bitangent sign) in the position's spare fourth u16, instead of 8 more bytes a vertex: a third of a normal-mapped vertex stream, the tangent within 0.03 degrees of the one before (an 8-bit normal map resolves about 0.45) (og.ModelPrimitive 5). Blobs re-cook; shading is unchanged.
